patterns.note: Project showcase sections utilize a dynamic, non-uniform grid layout where individual project cards vary significantly in size and aspect ratio, creating an editorial, magazine-like feel.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and set in a modern sans-serif typeface, providing strong visual hierarchy against lighter-weight body text and small, uppercase labels.
The site primarily uses a high-contrast palette of light grey backgrounds, dark text, and a vibrant electric blue as a primary accent color for calls to action and key branding elements.

An animated blue semi-circle expands and transforms to reveal the site's logo as a pre-loader, which then fades out to transition into the full page content. No scroll-triggered motion is observed on the page content itself.
Content sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (light grey, white, and dark grey/black) and generous vertical padding, maintaining visual separation and flow.

technique_notes: An initial loading animation features a geometric blue shape that expands and transforms to reveal the site's logo, then fades out to transition into the full page content.
Project displays are built using a flexible grid system that allows individual items to span multiple columns and rows, creating an asymmetrical and visually engaging arrangement.
Text hierarchy is established through a clear contrast between oversized, bold sans-serif headings and lighter, smaller body text, often accompanied by subtle uppercase labels for categorization.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy; generous vertical padding between sections, with well-distributed content within blocks.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic, non-uniform grid layout for showcasing projects, which breaks away from typical symmetrical grids to create a more editorial and visually stimulating experience. This, combined with the bold blue accent and sharp typography, gives it a unique, modern agency feel.
